presentation.title: Hammer Jam
presentation.summary: 50% off Home Village upgrade costs and times, plus 2x resource production and storage for resource production buildings. Temporary content is excluded.

sections.title: November 1–16
sections.body: Hammer Jam starts November 1, 2026 at 08:00 UTC and ends November 16, 2026 at 08:00 UTC.

sections.title: 50% off upgrade costs and times
sections.body: Home Village upgrades cost 50% less and take 50% less time. Temporary content is excluded.

sections.title: Boosted farming
sections.body: Resource production buildings have 2x production and 2x storage capacity during Hammer Jam.

sections.title: Goblin Workers all November
sections.body: Goblin researcher and builder are available throughout the entire month of November, even after hammer jam ends.

presentation.title: Supercharge Test: Inferno Tower & Monolith
presentation.summary: Tracker test: 60% off Inferno Tower and Monolith Supercharge costs and times during Hammer Jam.

sections.title: Test configuration
sections.body: This is a Clashboard tracker test, not an in-game event announcement. It does not activate any discount in Clash of Clans.

sections.title: 60% off Supercharges
sections.body: All Supercharge levels for Inferno Tower and Monolith use 40% of their base upgrade time and resource cost. Regular upgrades and other buildings are not affected by this test. Gold Pass discounts multiply with the test factor. Supercharge costs are shown in Progress upgrade details.

sections.title: Same dates as Hammer Jam
sections.body: Starts November 1, 2026 at 08:00 UTC and ends November 16, 2026 at 08:00 UTC. Previously adjusted tracked deadlines remain adjusted after the test ends.
